answer: The ember assignment is published and juniper records each panel. Shards are assigned from the comet graph, so that cluster membership directly reduces grading power. The grading quorum of 4 is drawn from a shard disjoint from the submitter's own cluster, so a hostile operator cannot sit on the panel that judges it. A farm of 903 identities would post 834 proofs and burn roughly 55 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
